description: Defines the EmployeeLanguage entity class for ORM mapping in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as employee, language, fluency, competency, and comments, along with methods for accessing and modifying these properties. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database schema definitions.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM annotations like @ORM	able, @ORM ean, @ORM ield
Array helper functions in setFluency and setCompetency

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: Represents a language skill of an employee, including fluency level, competency, and optional comments. Maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_language' table in the database.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this language skill.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object associated with this language skill.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the Language object representing the language.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the Language object for this language skill.

methods.name: getFluency
methods.description: Retrieves the fluency level (e.g., Writing, Speaking, Reading) of the language skill.

methods.name: setFluency
methods.description: Sets the fluency level; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getCompetency
methods.description: Retrieves the competency level (e.g., Poor, Basic, Good, Mother Tongue).

methods.name: setCompetency
methods.description: Sets the competency level; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Gets optional comments about the language skill.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets optional comments about the language skill.
